summary.text: Incomplete rank six Immortal Gu House Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance lends Shark Demon for assaults on Yu Lu blessed land.

claims.text: Trapped by a battlefield killer move paired with vanishing immortal essence dissipation rain inside Yu Lu blessed land, Shark Demon decides the group’s only choice is to use Profound Ice House and force a path. The other Gu Immortals are overjoyed he borrowed it for the trip. Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance is said to hold three Immortal Gu Houses, with only one complete and the other two extremely incomplete; even an incomplete house can be forcibly activated with great power. Shark Demon borrowed Profound Ice House from the alliance at a huge price under Su Bai Man’s urging.

He takes out a house that is not large, shaped like a ball resembling a block of ice. The air turns cold when it appears. Inside is a huge ball-shaped space with no furniture, cold white light, and golden threads that weave into a formation chart; the immortals stand on the formation core and expend immortal essence, which the house records. After several minutes an icy meteor breaks the Eastern Sea surface, then reveals itself as the rank six Immortal Gu House, incomplete Profound Ice House. Against that battlefield killer move the house can get them out of the blessed land but cannot break the move itself. Shark Demon later tells Tai Bai Yun Sheng that the house’s greatest purpose is to help ice path Gu Immortals cultivate, that its interior is extremely damaged and only barely usable after repairs, and that a complete Immortal Gu House could defend even while they stayed inside.
On another assault, the group does not last seven minutes under fighting soul battlefield before Shark Demon and the others must use incomplete Profound Ice House to escape.

When soul beasts later surround them near success at dismantling fighting soul battlefield, Shark Demon activates the incomplete house without hesitation; it takes everyone in, charges through the army, and tears soul beasts apart until ancient soul beasts pin it and burn immortal essence hard.

Inside the house the immortals’ own methods are restricted, because offense, defense, movement, healing, and investigation follow the house’s Gu rather than the passengers’ free use of killer moves. Profound Ice House still resists the soul beasts’ final frenzy until fighting soul battlefield collapses, and the group later uses the house again to charge out of Yu Lu blessed land after facing eight doors labyrinth.

In a later recollection, Fang Yuan notes that the Profound Ice House used by Shark Demon and Su Bai Man was only incomplete, yet could repeatedly break through battlefield killer moves and escape. When Shark Demon had to activate it, all the immortal zombies shared the immortal essence burden, and the consumption distressed everyone. Fang Yuan also treats Immortal Gu Houses as able to absorb others’ immortal essence for that shared activation, using Profound Ice House as the example.
After Spectral Soul’s capture leaves Shadow Sect defeated, its remaining resources include construction plans for twelve Immortal Gu Houses, and Profound Ice House is named among them.
